notes.title: Islands of Insight | What's Next
notes.content:
Update Oct. 30: Islands of Insight is now offline-only.

Seekers, our final Islands of Insight update will arrive on October 30, 2024, which will permanently modify the game to be offline-only. This will allow Islands of Insight to live on for all Seekers to find and enjoy, while we focus our efforts onto our next projects.

For what to expect, here is what you need to know:     

 The online servers will officially shutdown on October 30, 2024
 Any online progression that is not transferred before October 30 will be lost
 There are no plans for more content to support the offline version
 All the online features will no longer be available
 Puzzles will continue to respawn throughout all zones
 There will be no bug fixes/balance changes with the final update, however we are reducing the frequency of player position saving in response to community feedback about SSD wear and potential file corruption.  
 

How to transfer your progression:  

 Launch the game, and choose Play Online
 In the main menu, select Account and Click on Download Gameplay Progress
 A confirmation popup will appear: Click on Download Progress to start the download 
 After a few seconds, confirmation that the download was successful will appear and you are all done
 Exit the game, and start it again, but this time select Play Offline to continue playing your own progression. 


**Additional note: if you had already previously downloaded progression, the button will display “Override Progress” instead. You can decide if you want to replace it with your current online progression or not.

If you have any issue, please reach out to our customer service here https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us


We remain extremely proud of the many puzzles we’ve solved together in our shared-world. We sincerely thank you for all your support throughout this journey!

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Offline Mode Available Now!
notes.content:
Seekers, it is here. Our Offline Mode is live now!

We are happy to expand our play experience and provide more players with the opportunity to join us in the islands and solve beautiful puzzles. 

For what to expect, we covered the details in our previous post, but in case you missed it, here are the highlights:

 You no longer need to be tethered to an internet connection to play the game
 The world is still brimming with puzzles and has the same biomes. Puzzles will also respawn, and you will be able to do daily quests
 Any social / online functionality, like emoting or pinging other players will not be available in this mode
 Content has been balanced, modified or removed to fit with the single player experience


A world brimming with puzzles await for you. See you on the islands!

Update 1.2.6 Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:

 Party invite button, which can currently be found in your Friend menu while playing, is fixed. 
 Hidden Pentad shrinking bubble upgrade now works as intended. 
 Players will no longer experience any soft locks when using Fast Travel. 
 Issue with Enclaves losing progression is fixed. 
 Archipelago of Curiosity objectives will now all appear in the Quest Log as intended. 
 Quest log will now reflect remaining amount of puzzles to solve for multiple Enclaves that had been missing 
 Additional graphical and performance improvements. 


Known Issues:

 Eye of the Needle enclave primary goal grants two Mirabilis’ at once. 
 Map markers may cause solid collisions on some puzzles 
 Gather No Moss – Multiple Rolling Block puzzles in the location do not zoom in correctly when using ultrawide screen. 
 A Party leader is unable to disband the party by leaving it from the Pause Menu. 

The following bugs only impact the Demo version of IOI: 
 After downloading save file and switching from Online to Offline on the Demo, Question For Perfection challenge is not marked as complete 
 Two for One - Challenge cannot be completed due to lack of puzzles

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Patch Notes - Version 1.1.0b
notes.content:
Hello Seekers, 

Today we released an update with new content and technical improvements! Read below for details: 

New Content 

Added The Archipelago of Curiosities—a large bonus endgame Enclave featuring some unusual and creative twists on your favourite puzzles. The entrance is off to the side of the Haven of Insight along the path toward Serene Deluge. 

Added new grid rules and a new grid symbol. Awaken them by completing Bent Into Shape and Nearsighted—two new challenges in Autumn Falls and Serene Deluge respectively. New puzzles using each rule will spawn daily in the areas surrounding those challenges. 

Added Two for One, Cross the Streams, Found the Difference, The Puzzle Cube, and See Serpents—five new themed logic grid challenges spread across the map. 

Added Ground Away—a tricky group of Pillars of Insight in Serene Deluge. 

Added a fresh pack of high-difficulty logic grids along the path between the Haven of Insight and the entrance to Shattered Library. There are now 5 spawn locations for these difficult puzzles instead of 3. 

Added a new set of Black Iris wings for all players! Please note, these will be automatically added to your inventory!  

Finally, a somewhat unusual area has appeared beneath the Haven of Insight. 

Bug Fixes 


 Fixed progression blockers. 
 Echoes of Time should no longer be locked after a game relaunch. 
 Armillary Rings should now spawn as intended (flat ring bug). 
 Unlocked Ethereal Glow hair will no longer appear locked when relaunching the game. 
 To those who experienced the Ethereal Glow hair bug, please note that we will be adding the accessory back into your inventory on 04.17 after 3 PM ET. 
 The number of solved puzzles in the Vault of Vitric will now accurately be displayed in the Quest Log. 
 Players should no longer be randomly kicked from parties. 
 Additional fixes to the Friends List social feature. 
 Additional performance and graphical improvements. 


Known Issues 

General

 A Party leader is unable to disband the party by leaving it from the Pause Menu. 
 Some Friends’ avatar icons may be corrupted.
 Using the “I’m Stuck” button during a short blackout animation from Fast Travel may cause the screen to stay black.
 Teleporting to Warp Beacon while using zoom function may lock the Player’s zoomed-in screen after the teleport.

Location 

 Archipelago of Curiosity  
 Quest inside the Enclave is displayed on the map. 
 “100% Complete!” text is not displayed in the quest log once the Enclave is maxed out.
 Lucent Waters
 Gather No Moss – Multiple Rolling Block puzzles in the location do not zoom in correctly when using ultrawide screen. 

Map

 The icon on the map for “A Snake in the Grass” (Serene Deluge) is the same for a completion and 100% completion. 
 The challenge “The Flames of the Enlightenment” shows “0/0” Puzzles being available.

Daily Quests

 The following quests do not display the number of puzzles to solve: 
 “Solve Flow Orbs and Glide Rings”, “Solve Light Motifs and Crystal Labyrinths”, “Solve Perspective Puzzles”, and “Solve Environmental Puzzles”.


Thank you for your support!
The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Patch Notes - Version 1.0.13a
notes.content:
Hello Seekers, 

Today we released a new patch that addresses various issues. Please see details below. 

General game fixes 

 Fixed an issue affecting some players where selecting Play Game would result in a crash and UE4 crash report.
 Improved server synchronization. 
 Improvements to reported rubber banding and server connection issues. 
 Players previously unable to complete Enclaves, and hence blocked in their campaign, should now be unblocked. 
 Enclave progress will no longer reset upon launch.  
 Each zone on the map will now display the correct Mirabilis count. 
 Customization items that could previously not be unlocked, are now available and displaying as intended. 
 Wing unlock now behaving as intended. 
 Fixes to Party features, including pings and emotes now behaving and appearing as intended. 
 Several graphical & interactive (collision/clipping) fixes. 
 Naming discrepancies between different areas in the game and menus have been fixed. 
 Unlocking secrets and opening secret animations in the Encyclopedia no longer cause issues. 


Puzzle specific fixes 

 For those impacted, Rolling Block puzzles are now available in the Enclave, Gather No Moss. Completing the Enclave will now also display information about unlocking this puzzle type. 
 Sentinel Stone pillars now appear as intended in the environment. 
 Solving puzzles in The Temple of Infinite Rings will now impact your quest log and progress will not reset. 
 Invisible wall is no longer present in one of The Glass Temple’s Crystal Labyrinth. 
 Skydrop mastery now impacted by the Skydrop Combo.
 Holding X to reset (Glide Rings, Crystal Labyrinth) now works as intended. 


Thank you all for your patience and support, and if you experience any other issues, please be sure to contact our support team here:  https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Frequently Asked Questions & Dev Notes
notes.content:
Hello, Seekers! 
Here are some of the most frequently asked questions to help you know what to expect on Islands of Insight!

Frequently Asked Questions 

Requirements 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749783/8d41151413fcba848b4c9d4c14f3bacc1d6a3255.png

How do I add friends? 
In order to play in the same party, both players must have launched Islands of Insight once. This will ensure you can appear on each other's in-game friend lists. 

 Once this has been done and you re-launch the game, press 'Tab' or click on the Tab icon at the top right to see your in-game friend list. Press the 'Join' button next to your friend's name. This will allow you to join the server your friend is in. 
 Now that you are on the map, simply press 'ESC' to view the menu, and press the 'Join' button here to invite your friend to your party. 
 Once they have accepted your invitation, you will be able to see them in your 'Party'. 
 You will be able to spot them easily when you meet them on the map, even if they go behind a wall. 

If I played the demo, will my progress carry over? 
Yes! Your progress from the February demo will carry over into the full version of the game. 

Is there support for controllers? 
There is no support for the use of controllers for Islands of Insight at this time. 

Is there Steam Deck support? 
Islands of Insight is currently only supported and best played on Windows, you can view our minimum requirements here. Steam Deck, Mac, and Linux are currently not supported for Islands of Insight but we appreciate the feedback players have provided us so far. 

How do I change my name? 
Your in-game name is taken from your Steam profile name. If you update your Steam name, it will update in-game the next time you boot Islands of Insight.

Is there a cap to a puzzle's Mastery level? 
Yes, the highest level that you can achieve for the Mastery of any puzzle is level 99. 
Note: The bar may appear to move after you have hit level 99 

How do I find more info about a specific puzzle? 
The Encyclopedia contains all the information regarding the puzzles you have discovered so far. Make sure to use it to your advantage! 

Want to see the full FAQ or experiencing an issue? Please contact us here: 
https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

Developer’s Notes 

I played the Early Playtest in September and/or the most recent demo during Steam Next Fest. What changes can I expect to find in the full game?  

 The complete experience: 4 new biomes filled with new puzzle types, Enclaves and challenges. 
 New daily quests - more quest types and the ability to cancel quests, giving the player greater agency.  
 Improved player progression: addition of puzzles awakening, which adds improved sense of progression in completing the campaign, and ensures players engage with tutorials at the right time. 
 Revisions on lore, map, costume art, user interface, puzzle collection, difficulty, and several Enclaves. 
 And we also did something special with the pyramid...

The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Year Retrospective
notes.content:
Hello Seekers, 

As the sun rises on a new year, we have been reflecting on the adventures we’ve had and anticipating those on the horizon.  

Thanks to you, 2023 was a year filled with our own Eureka moments! Here are the adventures you joined us on: 


 Our reveal in June at PC Gaming Show, where we announced our title, got to show off gameplay and so much more of the world 
 The Open Playtest in September, where thousands of you explored and solved on the Islands for the first time 
 Our recent PC Gaming show appearance, where we announced that IOI is coming in February – JUST A MONTH AWAY 

And the support was amazing – in total, over 7.2 million puzzles were solved during these limited events! 

Thank you all for making Islands of Insight a reality and be sure to stay tuned as we’ll have more coming later this month. 

If you’re excited about the game, please support us by wishlisting! Each wishlist from you and your friends counts. We'll see you soon on the islands, 

The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Open Steam Playtest Build Notes
notes.content:
Content 

 An early zone of the map is available for the open playtest. The flow for the Main Campaign and puzzle content have been modified to fit with the playable area available. 
 Some assets are placeholders and not reflective of the final game. 


Features 

 For this open playtest we are focusing on your solo journey so only a few social interactions are available at this time. 
 Our progression systems and their UI/UX are still being worked on and may not be indicative of their final implementation. 


Game Balancing 

 The progression and difficulty scaling are not yet fully balanced. 
 Your experience points (XP) and Currencies (Coins) are not yet fully balanced, so your playstyle might influence your progression rate in unexpected ways. 


Known Issues 

The game is in pre-beta development therefore you may encounter bugs during your play experience. Currently known issues: 


 The only aspect ratio that is supported is 16:9, other aspect ratios (4:3, 21:9, etc.) are not currently supported. 
 There is no support for the use of controllers during the Open Steam Playtest. 
 If you believe you have encountered another issue, please head over to our support team’s portal. 


For more updates on Islands of Insight follow us on X and TikTok. You can also Wishlist the game here to get notified when the game launches. 


System Requirements 

Minimum Specs 


 OS: Windows 7 
 Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 
 Memory: 8 GB 
 Graphics: NVidia GTX 970 or Radeon R9 380. 4GB VRAM 
 Network: Yes 
 DirectX version: 11 or later 
 Disk Space: 30 BG. SSD recommended
 

Recommended Specs 


 OS: Windows 7, Direct X 11 or later 
 Processor: Intel Core i5-9500 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 
 Memory: 16 GB 
 Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 or Radeon RX 5700. 8GB VRAM 
 Network: Yes 
 DirectX version: 11 or later 
 Disk Space: 30 BG. SSD recommended

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Open Steam Playtest Available Now!
notes.content:
We are excited to bring the game to your hands for the first time during our Open Steam Playtest! Live until September 21st at 10AM PDT / 1 PM EDT, the playtest will be the first opportunity for you to dive into an epic journey of puzzles, exploration, and discovery, and share your feedback. Get a taste of Islands of Insight’s expansive world, game mechanics, and puzzles, with lots still left to discover down the road.

As part of the open playtest, you will be able to:   

 Seek out and solve a wide array of puzzles densely spread across the landscape.  
 Freely explore an open world filled with secrets to discover at your own pace.   
 Complete puzzle quests to progress the game’s campaign, unlock new areas, and reveal lore.   
 Contribute to improving the Islands of Insight experience by sharing feedback directly with the development team. 

Join our Open Steam Playtest by visiting our Steam page and click the “Request Access” button under the playtest header.

Anyone who is 16+ years old can join our Open Steam Playtest.

For those curious about what they can expect during the Playtest, check out our new Gameplay Reveal Trailer!

[previewyoutube=oERzysRyg5M;full][/previewyoutube]
A few key points to remember:

 Must be 16+ years old to join our Open Steam Playtest.
 For this Open Steam Playtest, you will be able to play an early part of the full game. As this is a pre-beta Playtest, please note that quality, content, progression and economy balance, UI/UX and performance are still being worked on and are not reflective of the final game.
 Share your experience! The contents of the Open Steam Playtest are not under NDA, so feel free to stream or make videos! Don't forget to tag us on X and TikTok!
 Open Steam Playtest access is available on Steam. Head to the Islands of Insight Steam Page and press “Play the Islands of Insight Playtest now” button under the Playtest header.
 Open Steam Playtest is time-limited and will run for two weeks - from September 7 at 10AM PDT/1 PM EDT to September 21 at 10AM PDT/1 PM EDT, 2023.
 Playtest Surveys are vital for us to continue polishing the experience. Please take your time to fill out the in-game surveys when they become available. You can also share your feedback on our Steam Community Hub.
 Your progression will not carry over to future Playtests or the launch version of the game.

Join Playtest Now!
